description: Deterministic risk rule configuration for the SAP Purchase Order Risk Checker. Every threshold used by the engine lives here - no rule may hardcode a limit.

high_risk_suppliers.reason: Sanctions screening hit pending clearance (fictional demo entry)
Financial distress signal: credit rating downgraded (fictional demo entry)
Repeated quality incidents and open compliance audit (fictional demo entry)

PO-R001.name: Duplicate purchase orders
PO-R001.recommended_action: Compare the purchase orders in ME23N before goods receipt or invoice posting and cancel the redundant document.

PO-R002.name: Duplicate line items within a purchase order
PO-R002.recommended_action: Review the purchase order items and delete or reduce the duplicated line before goods receipt.

PO-R003.name: Split purchases
PO-R003.recommended_action: Consolidate the demand into a single purchase order or a contract call-off and confirm the correct approval level was applied.

PO-R004.name: Order value just below an approval threshold
PO-R004.recommended_action: Verify with the requisitioner why the order stops just short of the release threshold and check for related orders.

PO-R005.name: Unusual unit price increase
PO-R005.recommended_action: Request a price justification from the supplier and check the info record and contract conditions.

PO-R006.name: Price variance for the same material
PO-R006.recommended_action: Benchmark the paid price against the material median and renegotiate or redirect volume to the best price supplier.

PO-R007.name: Off-contract purchase
PO-R007.recommended_action: Route the demand through the existing outline agreement or document an approved exception.

PO-R008.name: Missing contract reference on a significant order
PO-R008.recommended_action: Add the outline agreement reference or confirm that a free-text purchase was justified.

PO-R009.name: High value order without approval
PO-R009.recommended_action: Block the order for goods receipt and obtain the missing release before processing continues.

PO-R010.name: Late delivery
PO-R010.recommended_action: Review the supplier delivery performance in the next business review and update the planned delivery time if needed.

PO-R011.name: Requested delivery date before order date
PO-R011.recommended_action: Correct the delivery schedule line; a backdated requirement date distorts MRP and supplier performance reporting.

PO-R012.name: Actual delivery before order date
PO-R012.recommended_action: Investigate the goods receipt: a receipt before the order date usually indicates an after-the-fact purchase order.

PO-R013.name: Quantity anomaly
PO-R013.recommended_action: Confirm the ordered quantity with the requisitioner before the goods receipt is posted.

PO-R014.name: Currency anomaly
PO-R014.recommended_action: Verify the document currency against the company code default and correct the order if it was keyed incorrectly.

PO-R015.name: Missing required fields
PO-R015.recommended_action: Complete the missing purchase order attributes; incomplete documents block automated matching and reporting.

PO-R016.name: Unusual payment terms
PO-R016.recommended_action: Confirm the deviating payment terms were approved by treasury; non-standard terms affect working capital.

PO-R017.name: Excessive manual changes
PO-R017.recommended_action: Review the change documents (transaction ME23N, environment > changes) to confirm every amendment was authorised.

PO-R018.name: Supplier concentration in a material group
PO-R018.recommended_action: Assess single-source dependency for this category and qualify an alternative supplier.

PO-R019.name: Maverick spending
PO-R019.recommended_action: Redirect the demand to the contracted supplier for this material and coach the requisitioner on the catalogue process.

PO-R020.name: Purchase from a high-risk supplier
PO-R020.recommended_action: Apply the enhanced due diligence process before release and check whether an alternative supplier can serve the demand.
